2609.11319.title: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
2609.11319.paper_summary: Most of mathematical knowledge has been communicated through so-called informal use of mathematics and natural language. With large language models (LLMs) being highly adept in using natural language, they achieve strong performance, yet not perfect, in informal mathematical reasoning. Restraining LLMs to informal reasoning misses out on the opportunity to use the discrete verification abilities that machines offer through machine-checkable proofs. In this paper, we bridge the gap between informal and formal reasoning by integrating Lean signals into the informal reasoning process. We introduce Magenta, a training-free agentic pipeline that, given only a natural-language problem, produces an answer, expresses it as a Lean 4 statement, and constructs a machine-checked proof. A statement judge verifies whether the formalisation preserves the original problem, while an error-attribution judge routes failed attempts either to mathematical re-derivation or local Lean repair. Magenta achieves 100% accuracy across all evaluated olympiad benchmarks, including AIME 2025, AIME 2026, and HMMT February 2026. When paired with the open-weight K2-Horizon-7B reasoner, it solves all six IMO 2026 problems. Our analysis shows that statement adjudication is essential for preventing false certificates and that feedback-guided correction outperforms independent resampling on difficult problems.
2609.11319.paper_summary_zh: 大多數數學知識是通過所謂的非正式數學使用和自然語言進行交流的。隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）在使用自然語言方面的高超能力，它們在非正式數學推理中取得了強勁的表現，但並不完美。將LLMs限制於非正式推理會錯失利用機器可檢查證明所提供的離散驗證能力的機會。在本文中，我們通過將Lean信號整合到非正式推理過程中來彌合非正式與正式推理之間的差距。我們介紹了Magenta，一個無需訓練的代理管道，僅根據自然語言問題生成答案，將其表達為Lean 4語句，並構建機器檢查的證明。一個語句評審會驗證形式化是否保留了原始問題，而一個錯誤歸因評審則將失敗的嘗試路由到數學重新推導或本地Lean修復。Magenta在所有評估的奧林匹克基準中達到了100%的準確率，包括AIME 2025、AIME 2026和HMMT 2026年2月。當與開放權重的K2-Horizon-7B推理器配對時，它解決了所有六個IMO 2026問題。我們的分析顯示，語句裁定對於防止虛假證明是至關重要的，而基於反饋的修正在困難問題上優於獨立重採樣。
